validationRules: one primary search task per canonical URL
do not generate one article per synonym or AI fan-out query
prices require current official source and billing conditions
test claims require dated reproducible evidence
search-result snippets are discovery evidence, not verified rank or keyword volume
indexing is verified in search-engine webmaster tools; sitemap inclusion alone is not indexing
publish status must be checked after deploy; this map does not certify implementation
